title: Graph Neural Networks for Antisocial Behavior Detection on Twitter

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks (GraphSAGE, GAT, Graph Transformer) on classifying Twitter users as spreaders of stereotypes and determining their stereotype stance (in favor of or against a target) using the PAN IROSTEREO shared task dataset.

Measuring the accuracy of various Graph Neural Network architectures in detecting Twitter users who spread hate speech, formulated as a node classification problem on heterogeneous graphs using a PAN shared task dataset.
